summary: The Interim Superintendent of the Utica City Schools urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program and reject any proposal to eliminate or sunset it, emphasizing the essential role of reliable broadband in modern public education. The district discusses the impact of potential changes to E-Rate funding on its budget, capital planning, and equity considerations. A reduction in E-Rate funding would increase local costs and require long-term planning for technology improvements and infrastructure upgrades.
